lakes.note: polygons: the Environment Agency's WFD lakes, outlines simplified to 15 m. err: the most, in metres, an outline is off from the real one in lake_outlines/<place in polygons>.json. lake: index into lakes; null when no monitored overflow upstream reaches it; -1 when no lake centreline is inside the lake: a click there takes the lake centreline nearest it within lake_snap_m (link index), else it is isolated. lakes[].inlets: where water enters the lake, and o = flat triples (overflow index, distance along the network m, dilution x 10000 before dividing by 1 + area / 5 km2); k = flat triples (overflow index, metres of another WFD lake crossed on the way, which travel at the lake velocity, lake factor x 1000000 to multiply the dilution by) for the overflows in o whose water crosses one; h = flat quadruples (lake path residence: overflow index, metres of those lakes with a residence time, which do not travel at the lake velocity, survivors' hours in them x 1000 added to the travel time, share alive x 1000000000 to multiply the die-off by). lakes[].water: true where lake_water/<place in lakes>.json has the lake's water (lake distance water): corners, the reflex corners of the lake's water (model/lake_water.py); inside, its outline widened by 10 m, which a straight way must stay in; shore, its outline, for a click outside it; ways, one per inlet in order: where it enters the water (lon, lat), the metres to there, then the metres through the water to each corner, -1 where none.
